title: Nexus BatchUpdateFindingsResponse
description: Response for PATCH /v1/daemon/findings/batch. Returns partial-success counts and lists of IDs that could not be updated. Always HTTP 200 unless the request exceeds the cap or a DB error occurs.

not_found.description: IDs that do not exist or are not owned by the active creator.

conflict.description: IDs where the requested status transition is illegal per the findings lifecycle.
